messages:
alex: quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood/sdks/pull/4321 is ready; it introduces a small API header change (X-Client-Tag) that console/runtime need to accept. this blocks console PR https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1098 and a helm chart bump in infra-helm. tagging @maria @jin @sam for rollout plan.

maria: thanks. can you briefly call out the compatibility? is the header optional? any proto changes? we need to know if runtime deserializers will break older clients.

alex: header is optional — nothing renamed or removed. implementation is basically: `if req.headers.get("X-Client-Tag") { /* feature flag */ }` no proto changes. unit + integration tests passed locally.

jin: console will need to accept the header and pass it through to runtime. i'll hold merge on the console PR until api is live. prefer canary deploy first. @sam what's the next available canary window? :clock3:

sam: canary slots open today 16:00-17:00 PT or tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT. i can reserve 16:30 today and run a light canary. note: we saw a flaky e2e on sdk earlier — @deploy-bot any CI status?

deploy-bot: CI build #881 failed (integration timeout). rerun requested.

alex: re-ran the failing suite and fixed a timeout in the test harness. green now. command: `./scripts/test-integration --filter header` (ran twice).

priya: quick review notes — please add a CHANGELOG entry and a short migration note in docs. also add a tiny console integration test asserting header passthrough.

alex: will add changelog + migration note and a test by EOD. @jin once sdk is deployed and canary is green, i'll merge sdk PR and open the infra-helm bump PR.

jin: ack. adding a `hold/merge-window` label to the console PR. will merge in the same deployment window if things look good.

sam: reserved 16:30-17:00 PT today for canary. plan: route 5% traffic to new endpoint for 30 mins, monitor errors & latencies, then 50% if stable. i'll post snapshots here.

deploy-bot: canary started at build #882 (2629987810). healthcheck: OK, initial 5% routed.

maria: monitoring KV cache and RPC errors — no anomalies so far, latency p50 unchanged.

jin: console e2e passing locally & in CI smoke. queuing merge after sam confirms canary.

sam: canary green across 30m window. promoting to 50% then full. nothing flagged. go ahead. :thumbsup:

alex: merged https://github.com/redwood/sdks/pull/4321 and opened infra helm bump PR https://github.com/redwood/infra-helm/pull/77 — added CHANGELOG and migration note.

jin: merged console PR after infra bump went in. thanks team.

priya: created a follow-up task to remove the temporary compatibility shim in ~6 weeks. marking as backlog item.

alex: appreciated — leaving a comment on the backlog task with the exact shim filename. thanks everyone!
